definition: HKChat (Chinese: 港話通) is a large language model-based chatbot developed by HKChat OmniServe Limited (Chinese: 港話通全維服務有限公司) in Hong Kong.
details: HKChat (Chinese: 港話通) is a large language model-based chatbot developed by HKChat OmniServe Limited (Chinese: 港話通全維服務有限公司) in Hong Kong.

explainer.lead: HKChat (港話通) is a large language model-based chatbot developed by HKChat OmniServe Limited (港話通全維服務有限公司) in Hong Kong. It matters as a regionally developed conversational assistant.

tiers.eli5: It is a chatbot built on a large language model, made by a company in Hong Kong.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers would integrate it as a conversational assistant backed by a large language model. A pitfall is assuming capabilities beyond what its developers document.
